pages.title: The Bench Knows the Store
pages.text: Take a crafted result from a connected crafting terminal using the network’s ingredients.

pages.title: The Bench Knows the Store
pages.text: Let the store supply your workbench.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Install a Crafting Terminal on a working network, put ingredients in connected containers and craft a simple item through the terminal. Take the result; opening the screen alone is not enough.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Attach a Storage Terminal or Crafting Terminal to the connected inventory network. Browse stored items; the crafting variant also provides a crafting grid.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Select AE-style, Refined Storage-style or vanilla-style controls and use the matching pull-one/transfer-one gestures shown by the terminal. Change item transfer gestures; sorting, kept search text, synchronized search and player-inventory crafting pull are separate terminal settings.
